name: resultflow-whatsapp
description: Workspace-scoped WhatsApp tools connected through ResultFlow.

interface.shortDescription: Use your connected WhatsApp securely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds workspace-scoped tools for WhatsApp chats, messages, contacts, groups, connection state, and supported create, read, update, and delete actions. Connection uses the one-time setup prompt issued after ResultFlow onboarding.
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on today's WhatsApp chats.
Who still needs a reply on WhatsApp?
What did my WhatsApp groups approve?
